toolbar.editingDefaultHint: Changes here are what every user without their own dashboard sees.
toolbar.phoneArrangeHint: Drag and resize widgets on a larger screen. Here you can edit, copy and remove them.

confirm.useDefault: Remove your own dashboard and use the default one?
confirm.restoreBuiltIn: Remove everyone's default dashboard? Users without their own will see the built-in dashboard.

empty.title: No widgets yet
empty.body: Choose Customize, then Add widget to build your dashboard.

metric.name: Total
metric.description: One number: what you own, what it cost, what it's worth, or what your sales made.

breakdownTable.name: Breakdown table
breakdownTable.description: Holdings by game or category, or sales by game.

breakdownChart.name: Breakdown chart
breakdownChart.description: What your holdings are worth per game, as a pie chart.

searchSummary.name: Search totals
searchSummary.description: How many cards match a search, and what they cost and are worth.

searchCards.name: Most valuable cards
searchCards.description: The top cards matching a search, sorted by value, price or date added.

searchGroups.name: Cards by set
searchGroups.description: Cards matching a search, totaled per set, rarity, location or more, as a chart.

sql.name: SQL query
sql.description: Your own read-only SELECT over the database, shown as a number, table or chart.

sqlOrders.name: Orders per month
sqlOrders.description: An example SQL widget: a line chart of orders by month.

sqlAdded.name: Cards added per month
sqlAdded.description: An example SQL widget: a column chart of cards added by month.

note.name: Note
note.description: Text for headings, reminders or links (Markdown).

editor.title: Edit widget
editor.gameHint: Widgets ignore the game picked in the top bar.
editor.queryHint: The same search syntax as the Collection page. Leave empty for every card.
editor.sqlHint: One read-only SELECT. Up to {{rows}} rows are returned; queries stop after {{seconds}} seconds.
editor.sqlReadOnly: You can move, resize and retitle this widget, but changing its query needs the Write SQL widgets permission.
editor.schemaHint: Click a name to insert it.
editor.colorBySign: Green when positive, red when negative
editor.previewHint: Run the query to see a preview.
